headline: No scored news; endings drift as earlier stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. The endings drifted by hundredths of a point as earlier announcements slowly faded from the calculation: the bright endings eased a touch while Conquerors and Zookeeper ticked up. Horizon Balance edged down to +1.46.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); Libertarian Utopia and Conquerors shifted most, by a hundredth each, from fading contributions.
